lines: The Phase 2 gate ran with the film and the app in: every machine check that can pass before the blockout film is green, and the judged list of 69 pictures is written.
The hero camera is refitted so the lifted globe stays in frame through a shake, and the interface is finished and merged.
Next: the new stage replaces the measuring scene, then the blockout round and the publish with a globe you can shake.
phase 2: 2.71 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 3.90 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The controls at twice their size, on a mock: idle, dimmed, busy, hover, pressed, then keyboard focus on Shake, on a season mark and on sound, sound on, and the hint pulse at its middle. (by interface_builder)

Spring, summer and fall from the particle engine, same debug plot: the last stroke, landed, and settling to rest. Petals lie on the ground and the roof, summer's motes and fireflies float, fall's leaves settle with two ember columns and the bats. (by particles_builder)

The particle engine, winter, the full pool of 102000: a debug plot of positions with streaks along each velocity, from the start of a shake to the landed state (0.02 s, 0.6 s lift, 1.2 s and 1.8 s strokes, 2.4 s landing, 2.9 s). Not the app's drawing. (by particles_builder)

The first shake from the hero camera after the fit, on the measuring scene, twelve frames from the lift to the landing. The camera is locked. It now stands a little further back with its aim raised, so the lifted globe stays inside the frame: before, the top of the glass left the picture.
